title.en: An Act to Authorize Frederick Garfield Waite and Others to Maintain and Action At Law Against the Government of the Philippine Islands and Authorizing the Attorney-General of the Philippine Islands to Appear therein.

text.en:
Authority is hereby granted to Frederick Garfield Waite, Luengo Martinez as administrator of
the estate of Pedro Gruet and Juana Moreno, Jose Alemany y Gruet, Juan Atayde y Gruet, Julio Atayde y
Gruet and Pedro Atayde y Gruel, to maintain an action in the Court of First Instance of the city of Manila
against the Government of the Philippine Islands and the Treasurer of the Philippine Islands to determine the
ownership of certain shares of the capital stock of the Banco Español-Filipino the certificates of which are in
the possession of the said Treasurer, and the Attorney-General of the Philippine Islands and the Treasurer of
the Philippine islands and defend said Government and Treasurer in said action.

this Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 8, 1909.
